platform_mcp_manomano_api_key.title: PLATFORM_MCP_MANOMANO_API_KEY
platform_mcp_manomano_api_key.description: API key generated by a Toolbox Admin under Settings > API keys (shown once; one key serves all of the seller's contracts); sent as the x-api-key header.

platform_mcp_manomano_seller_contract_id.title: PLATFORM_MCP_MANOMANO_SELLER_CONTRACT_ID
platform_mcp_manomano_seller_contract_id.description: Numeric seller contract id (one per ManoMano market and delivery type, shown in Toolbox); every call is scoped to it.

tools.name: me
tools.description: No account endpoint; the probe reads one online offer of the configured contract ({pagination, content[]}) to verify the key and contract id.

tools.name: update_listing
tools.description: update_offers PATCH /api/v2/offer-information/offers {content: [{seller_contract_id, items: [{sku, price: {price_vat_included}, stock: {quantity}}]}]} changes the LIVE price (VAT included, contract currency) and/or stock of one offer; `listing_id` is your SKU. By default ManoMano FREEZES the values sent so later feed imports do not overwrite them. Title/description come from the product feed and are not changed. A 207 answer lists per-SKU errors in raw.

tools.name: set_inventory
tools.description: update_offers with {sku, stock: {quantity}} sets the stock of one offer by SKU (`sku` required; the stock is frozen against feed imports by default).

tools.name: list_orders
tools.description: Orders API (REST) GET /orders/v1/orders?seller_contract_id&status(PENDING|WAITING_PAYMENT|REFUSED|PREPARATION|SHIPPED|REFUNDED|REFUNDING...)&created_at_start(ISO-8601 UTC)&limit&page. `id` is the order_reference (e.g. M2022080713464); total is total_price.amount VAT included; products, addresses and VAT data in raw. PENDING orders must be accepted (POST /orders/v1/accept-orders) before shipping; not done here.

tools.name: mark_shipped
tools.description: Create shippings POST /orders/v1/shippings [{order_reference, seller_contract_id, carrier, tracking_number}] moves the order to SHIPPED with one parcel covering the whole order (per-parcel products and tracking_url are not sent). Answers 204, or 207 with per-order errors in raw.content[].result.
